ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a vertical current-carrying straight wire AB, and the direction of current I is from B toward A, that is, upward; on the right side is a vertically placed rectangular closed coil abcd, and OO′ is the vertical axis of symmetry of the coil. AB is parallel to OO′, and the dashed line in the figure indicates the plane in which AB and OO′ lie; this plane is perpendicular to the plane of the coil. Reasoning: Judging according to the top view, the straight wire AB is on one side of OO′, and the current is upward. From the right-hand rule, it can be known that the magnetic field around the current-carrying straight wire forms rings around AB; near the center of the coil, the magnetic field direction is along the plane of the coil, so the initial magnetic flux passing through the coil is zero. If an induced current in the abcda direction is required to be produced in the coil, then the direction of the magnetic field produced by this induced current can be judged by the right-hand screw rule. According to Lenz's law, the magnetic field of the induced current should oppose the change in the external magnetic flux, so the magnetic flux of the external magnetic field passing through the coil should be made to increase in the direction opposite to the induced magnetic field. Comparing the cases in which the coil rotates clockwise and counterclockwise around the OO′ axis in the top view, when it rotates counterclockwise, the external magnetic flux increases in the required direction, and therefore a current in the abcda direction can be induced; when it has rotated through 90°, the magnetic flux reaches its maximum. Final answer: The coil rotates 90° counterclockwise around the OO′ axis (viewed from above).

method.method_draft: 先按图建立俯视判断：直导线AB在OO′一侧，电流沿AB向上；线圈abcd绕竖直对称轴OO′放置，初始时AB与OO′所在平面垂直于线圈平面。用右手定则判断通电直导线在OO′附近的磁场方向：俯视时磁场绕AB成环形，在线圈中心处沿线圈平面方向，因此初始穿过线圈的磁通量为零。再由所需感应电流方向abcda，用右手螺旋定则判断该感应电流产生的磁场方向。根据楞次定律，感应电流的磁场要阻碍外磁通量的变化，所以应使外磁场穿过线圈的磁通量向与感应磁场相反的方向增大。俯视比较顺、逆时针转动后线圈面积法线与直导线磁场的关系，可知绕OO′轴逆时针转动时，穿过线圈的外磁通量按所需方向增大，从而感应出abcda方向电流；转到90°时磁通量达到最大。因此操作为：线圈绕OO′轴逆时针转动90°（俯视）。

raw_record.answer: The coil rotates 90° counterclockwise around the OO′ axis (viewed from above)
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: On the left side of the figure is a vertical current-carrying straight wire AB, and the direction of current I is from B toward A, that is, upward; on the right side is a vertically placed rectangular closed coil abcd, and OO′ is the vertical axis of symmetry of the coil. AB is parallel to OO′, and the dashed line in the figure indicates the plane in which AB and OO′ lie; this plane is perpendicular to the plane of the coil.

Reasoning: Judging according to the top view, the straight wire AB is on one side of OO′, and the current is upward. From the right-hand rule, it can be known that the magnetic field around the current-carrying straight wire forms rings around AB; near the center of the coil, the magnetic field direction is along the plane of the coil, so the initial magnetic flux passing through the coil is zero. If an induced current in the abcda direction is required to be produced in the coil, then the direction of the magnetic field produced by this induced current can be judged by the right-hand screw rule. According to Lenz's law, the magnetic field of the induced current should oppose the change in the external magnetic flux, so the magnetic flux of the external magnetic field passing through the coil should be made to increase in the direction opposite to the induced magnetic field. Comparing the cases in which the coil rotates clockwise and counterclockwise around the OO′ axis in the top view, when it rotates counterclockwise, the external magnetic flux increases in the required direction, and therefore a current in the abcda direction can be induced; when it has rotated through 90°, the magnetic flux reaches its maximum.

Final answer: The coil rotates 90° counterclockwise around the OO′ axis (viewed from above).
